notes.title: v0.17: Minor Improvements
notes.content:
• The [u]cursor[/u] is now hollow inside, which should make it more comfortable to color smaller details of the in-game images. Also, its size has been increased to make sure its color is still clearly visible.
• The colorizable parts of a [u]title screen[/u] image should no longer overlap each other.
• [u]Transitions[/u] between levels have become smoother.
